blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Cebu’s heat index may reach 38 degrees Celsius on Monday, November 2, placing the province under the “extreme caution” category, according to the state weather bureau. In an advisory issued at 5 p.m. Sunday, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said the forecast follows five consecutive day of “extreme caution” heat index levels in the province. Under this category, Pagasa warned of possible heat cramps and heat exhaustion, as well as heat stroke during prolonged physical activity.
